_meta.drift_contract: `--check` compares the code-derived topology (surfaces, writers, readers, violations, overlaps, retired surfaces, coverage) and, only when the runtime probe is available, the service unit/port set. Per-service pid and invocation_id are observations and are never compared.

canonical_ownership.statement: Lilac owns ticket, receipt, execution-claim and fan-out behavior.
